record.question: Literacy rate is lowest in the state of
record.explanation: Answer A: Bihar. Bihar had the lowest literacy rate among the listed states in Census 2011. The Government of India's census-based table gives Bihar 61.8%, below Arunachal Pradesh 65.4%, Chhattisgarh 70.3% and Haryana 75.6%. Historical/source note: Census 2011 comparison relevant to this June 2014 paper, not a new annual literacy ranking. Reference: https://www.indiabudget.gov.in/economicsurvey/ebook_es2022/files/basic-html/page621.html. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
